message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of some of J.K. Rowling’s most popular books:

| Series / Title | Publication Year | Notes |
|----------------|------------------|-------|
| **Harry Potter** (7‑book series) | 1997–2007 | *Philosopher’s Stone* (UK)/*Sorcerer’s Stone* (US), *Chamber of Secrets*, *Prisoner of Azkaban*, *Goblet of Fire*, *Order of the Phoenix*, *Half‑Blood Prince*, *Deathly Hallows*. These are her flagship works and have sold over 500 million copies worldwide. |
| **Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them** | 2001 (novel) – 2016 (film tie‑in book) | A companion guide to the wizarding world that later became the basis for the film franchise. |
| **Quidditch Through the Ages** | 2001 | Another companion book detailing the history of Quidditch. |
| **The Tales of Beedle the Bard** | 2008 | A collection of wizarding fairy tales. |
| **The Casual Vacancy** | 2012 | Her first adult novel published under her own name; deals with social issues in a small English town. |
| **The Cuckoo’s Calling** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2013 | First in the “Cormoran Strike” detective series; she has since written several more under this pseudonym. |
| **The Silkworm** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2014 | Second in the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **Career of Evil** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2015 | Third in the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **Lethal White** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2018 | Fourth in the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **Troubled Blood** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2020 | Fifth in the Cormoran Strike series. |

These titles cover both her iconic fantasy universe and her ventures into adult fiction and crime mystery.
